title: Verifying Stokes' Theorem on a Hemispherical Cap
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Verify Stokes' Theorem for F = <-y, x, z> over upper hemisphere z = sqrt(1 - x^2 - y^2) bounded by unit circle C in the xy-plane.

steps.title: Evaluate Boundary Line Integral Directly
steps.mathExpression: \oint_C (-y \, dx + x \, dy + z \, dz) = \int_0^{2\pi} [-\sin t(-\sin t) + \cos t(\cos t) + 0] dt = \int_0^{2\pi} 1 \, dt = 2\pi
steps.explanation: Parametrize boundary circle x = cos(t), y = sin(t), z = 0.

steps.title: Evaluate Flux of Curl via Flat Base Disk
steps.explanation: By Stokes' Theorem, replace hemisphere with flat disk sharing boundary C.
